final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n FROM Customers cu JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cu.gender) <> '' GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, n, CAST(n AS REAL) / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, n AS order_count, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
